descriptive_only.replica-2-opening_priority: summary only until the offline six-model merge; its uniform partner (replica-2-uniform) is in the first part

interpretation: One matched training pair (replica 3) over 1024 shared evaluation seeds on a development cohort; replica-2 opening_priority is descriptive only here. No pair-2 or three-replicate pool is fabricated in this part (the offline merge forms them from the audited parts); no method superiority, selection, promotion or D5 confirmation claim.

paired_conditional_seed_intervals.interpretation: Conditional evaluation-seed uncertainty only, conditional on the fixed trained policies; one training pair is not a training-population estimate and 1024 matched seeds are not training replicates. Common global sampling seed does not imply per-seed common action draws after trajectories diverge. Extrema intervals are empirical-distribution bootstrap intervals, not population bounds. D4 ranking is development evidence, not D5 confirmation.
paired_conditional_seed_intervals.method: paired percentile bootstrap; shared index draws across policies; linear-interpolated quantiles
